messages:
jamie: Thanks everyone — quick thread for the leftover Qs from today's all-hands. I'll drop the items we didn't get to; please reply with owner + ETA.

maria: Timeline for Dedicated GA? Customers asking about commit terms and SLAs. :thinking_face:

sanjay: We're aiming for GA the week of May 12. SLA draft in progress. I'll post the doc this Friday: https://intra.redwood.ai/dedicated-ga-sla (WIP). Owner: sanjay — SLA draft by 2026-04-11.

elaine: On Private/on‑prem: what about airgap installer + HSM integration schedule? A few regulated accounts are waiting.

nate: Short answer — airgap installer alpha in late May, HSM/KMS hooks prototype by June. Owner: ops infra (nate) to share runbook next week.

robin: Migration path question from hosted->dedicated: are there any breaking config changes? any customer-facing CLI docs?

nate: Migration flow: 1) export customer configs, 2) pin model versions, 3) flip route in console. Example CLI: ```
# export routes
redwoodctl export --org acme --out acme-config.yaml
# update pin
redwoodctl pin --route /chat --model redwood-7b-v1
```
I'll add a step-by-step doc. Owner: nate — migration doc by 2026-04-15.

maria: Who owns the pricing/commit FAQ for Dedicated? We need wording for sales and self-serve.

sanjay: Pricing FAQ — maria to lead with finance. Owner: maria — FAQ draft + sample commit calculator by 2026-04-12.

elaine: For Redwood Optimize recommendations: will we expose an 'apply' button in console or just suggestions?

jamie: Product decision pending — quick poll: prefer one-click apply or safe-preview first? :thumbsup: one-click, :eyes: preview.

maria: I'd vote preview first. Ops teams want a visible diff for config changes.

sanjay: Agreed. Preview + rollback policy. Owner: product (jamie) to spin up spec. ETA 2026-04-09.

robin: Action item: collect 3 customer prompts for Optimize regression tests. Who owns?

maria: I'll coordinate with research and solutions eng. Owner: maria + research — collect by 2026-04-08.

dev-bot: Created tickets: LI-342 (Dedicated SLA draft), LI-343 (Migration docs), LI-344 (Optimize preview UX). Links: https://linear.redwood/LI-342, https://linear.redwood/LI-343, https://linear.redwood/LI-344

sanjay: Thanks — please tag me on LI-342. I'll review on Monday.

jamie: Great. Quick housekeeping: I'll compile these into a single follow-up email + add links to the all-hands notes page. If you add new items, reply here. :sparkles:

nate: I'll post the migration checklist draft by EOD Thursday in #eng-docs.

elaine: I'll raise the airgap install blockers doc and ping infra.

jamie: Closing loop — owners so far: sanjay (SLA), maria (pricing + prompts), nate (migration + airgap runbook), jamie (optimize spec). I'll update the follow-up doc by tomorrow.

robin: Thanks — super helpful. :clap:
